design: Fixed10 additional candidate families x8 source slots x2formats, paired answer-changing examples. Native competence only; no circuit/featurizer claims. Save all outcomes and tokenization exclusions. No equal-length filter at competence stage; alignment handled later.
split: A first4 source discovery, A last4 lexical, B first4 structural, B last4 joint. Whole-task training holdouts predeclared: continent_recall,object_function in this bank; existing sequence_copy,role_binding,spatial_inverse,tense remain excluded from training. These are development holdouts, not the original reserved test.
gate: Per family/split >=4 DISTINCT prompt pairs, >=.75 both-endpoint contrast correctness, >=.5 intended group full-vocabulary top1. Duplicated templates counted once; all are reported, no posthoc prompt replacement.
groups: Existing fixed agreement/sentiment/negation semantic groups; otherwise exact answer tokens. Strict single-token continuation boundary check; excluded pairs retained in report.
limits: Some prompts reuse prior research. Month-successor uses shared vocabulary across source splits. Other families have disjoint queried items within each format, but word parts and outputs may overlap. Continent and object-function prompts include broad/ambiguous labels and are diagnostic candidates, not established tasks. Semantic ambiguities and tokenization can make a format unsuitable without proving inability.
purpose: Screen breadth cheaply before expensive causal targets; no new training.
